However, capitalising on this new opportunity will require satcom stakeholders to overcome many challenges, such as demonstrating thetechnical validity ofB5G NTN solutions under specific operational environments while fulfilling industries requirements, and understanding how to natively integrate future 6GNTN services in the operations of these industries. Building and launching B5G NTN infrastructure and services involves complex, time consuming and costly transformationalprojects at every level of satellite and terrestrial systems.To fillthis gap, this activity will develop, validate and demonstrate B5G NTN solutions for various vertical markets, including direct-to-device, IoT, automotive, transportation,maritime, health, energy, agriculture and emergency response. The resulting systems will be validated and demonstratedusing over-the-air field trials allowing the concerned verticals to verify the performance of B5G NTN in a realistic operational conditions of their use cases.The activity will seek synergies with ARTES deliverables, testbeds, hubs, and in-orbit experiments, as well as with various European and national projects that are beingdeveloped.
